sections.text:
Analysing personal spending (trends, budgets, categories) → finance; you can hand it a CSV of `house history`.
Calendar events and personal plans → personal. Links, reels and the reading library → per

skills.name: cooking
skills.description: What to cook tonight, what to buy on the way home, and the household's dish book (dishes cooked before, ratings, recipes saved by personal).

skills.name: money
skills.description: Record shared spending, split it the right way between the household's money groups, settle up, and answer who owes whom.

skills.name: receipts
skills.description: Turn a grocery receipt (Woolworths photo, PDF or eReceipt email) or a spoken list into pantry items with expiry dates, and optionally the shared expense.

skills.name: workflows
skills.description: Route any household request to the right `house` command, record it, and reply; also covers bills, the daily reminder and incoming bill notices.
